name: rapidbm25
description: Fast local BM25 keyword search over texts or a code/docs folder. Rust core, no network.
long_description: Build in-memory BM25 indexes from a list of texts or from the files under a local folder, then run ranked keyword search. Good for exact identifiers, error strings and rare terms. Scoring is bit for bit identical to rank_bm25. Indexes live in memory; nothing leaves the machine; folder indexing is limited to the allowed directories.

tools.name: bm25_index_texts
tools.description: Build (or replace) a named in-memory BM25 index from a list of text documents.

tools.name: bm25_index_path
tools.description: Index text files under a local directory as line-window chunks for keyword search over code or docs.

tools.name: bm25_search
tools.description: Ranked BM25 keyword search in a named index; returns ids, scores and snippets.

tools.name: bm25_list_indexes
tools.description: List in-memory indexes and their sizes.
